description:
**Divergence**: 7 of 8 extension-client siblings mirror the canonical mail-client tests/helpers.rs pattern. sharing-client uses a different layout.

| Crate | helpers.rs | Other shared modules |
|---|---|---|
| mail-client (canonical) | YES (53 L: make_session + make_client) | — |
| chat-client | YES (226 L: canonical + chat-specific response shape helpers) | — |
| calendars-client | YES (61 L) | — |
| tasks-client | YES (53 L) | — |
| contacts-client | YES (53 L) | — |
| filenode-client | YES (53 L) | — |
| metadata-client | YES (54 L) | — |
| **sharing-client** | **NO** | **tests/common/mod.rs (70 L) + tests/helpers_smoke.rs + tests/fixtures/sharing/*.json** |

Structurally, sharing-client's tests/common/mod.rs:14, 60 defines the SAME functions (make_session + make_client) as the canonical mail-client/tests/helpers.rs:13, 43 — just in a different file with a different module declaration scheme.

**Caller-observable / maintainer effect**: a contributor opening sharing-client's tests sees common/mod.rs and expects something larger or shared across multiple test files (server-crate convention); finds it's the same thing every other client puts in helpers.rs. Two file extensions for tests are confusing — `mod common;` vs `mod helpers;` — the difference signals nothing.

**Plus two sharing-client-only assets**:
- tests/helpers_smoke.rs (29 L) — a smoke-test FOR THE HELPER ITSELF. No other extension-client crate has one.
- tests/fixtures/sharing/*.json — no other extension-client crate has a fixtures-dir.

**Fix**:
(a) Rename crate-jmap-sharing-client/tests/common/mod.rs → tests/helpers.rs; update `mod common;` declarations in sharing-client test files to `mod helpers;`. Matches canonical.
(b) Decide on the two sharing-client-only assets: either lift to canonical (add tests/helpers_smoke.rs and tests/fixtures/<crate>/ to all 8 client crates) OR remove from sharing-client. Status quo (sharing-specific extras with no precedent in the canonical and no AGENTS.md documenting why) violates the propagation rule.

**Cross-references**: bd:JMAP-ops7.1 (tasks-client receiver shape divergence, closed). Same crate-family cookie-cutter regression class.
title: sharing-client: uses tests/common/mod.rs + tests/helpers_smoke.rs + tests/fixtures/sharing/ for what every other extension-client sibling puts in a single tests/helpers.rs (cookie-cutter outlier)
